## Notes

Filed in Rutherford County, Civil district 13, Murfreesboro certificate 4328. 

Mr.s Elvira Ann Green. Birth: July 7, 1841; death: Feb. 22, 1928. Widowed.
Died of senility.


Father David Williams, born in Tennessee; mother Miss Harris, born in Tennessee.

Death reported by Mrs. I.N. Gattis.
